hints.title: Directed Acyclic Graph Model
hints.text: A directed edge from u to v indicates team u is stronger than team v.

hints.title: In-Degree Analysis
hints.text: A champion cannot be defeated by any team, meaning its in-degree must be strictly 0.

hints.title: Uniqueness Requirement
hints.text: Count all nodes with in-degree 0. If exactly one such node exists, return it; otherwise return -1.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear degree counting across DAG edges.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full reachability BFS from each node takes O(n * (n + m)).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify in-degree 0 property on DAG without performing redundant traversals.
